_readme: Ads for IradOne Online. Put images in ads/ and list them here. size is 'leaderboard' (728x90, also used on phones at full width) or 'box' (300x250). Each slot shows a random ad of its size; set active to false to pause one. link can be a full URL, '#', or a path on this site such as 'news/index.html'. Example: {"image": "ads/talasbank-728x90.jpg", "alt": "Talasbank: dollar and som accounts", "link": "#", "size": "leaderboard"}
